reviews.comment:
Course if very confusing, very limited feedback provided if at all. Homework is not graded in an adequate time, and lectures are very hard to follow. Dr. Mallick sometimes uses language that does not make sense. We've been told to only reach out to the TA and should not be emailing him. 
Take this course in the summer

If you even have a baseline understanding of statistics, this course should be easy to make an A in. The homework assignments can be long, but there is plenty of time to complete them. The course is geared towards real-word application of statistics for your own data using JMP. I highly recommend Dr. Mallick for an applied view on statistics.

Lectures are confusing, with important steps presented very rapidly, and use non-standard terminology, making it difficult to cross-reference the textbook. Homework assignments are graded for correctness, although some concepts on the homework are not covered in class. Minimal feedback is provided on what exactly is wrong with calculations.
